data.subject: accounting close at CesiumAstro
data.body:
Hi Sanjiv,

CesiumAstro is hiring a Corporate Controller to oversee general ledger accounting, financial close, and reconciliations. Coming from controllership and governance at NXP, adding leadership for those areas usually indicates that manual close workloads and compliance demands are increasing.

Block removed 75% of human touchpoints in the accounting close.

Are you open to a 20-minute call next week to see how Zamp's AI agents automate this?

[Your name]
